description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for the Authentication API in a Java backend. It contains nested static classes for signup requests, login requests, and authentication responses, including validation annotations and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: SignupRequest
classes.description: DTO for user signup requests, including username and password with validation and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for user login requests, including username and password with validation and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: DTO for authentication API responses, containing a message string.
